reasoning_contract_checks.scope: Predefined synthetic software contracts, not expert ground truth or measured scientific performance.

preservation.current_audit_manifest_bookkeeping: The manifest records the command-ledger prefix before its own final command was appended; that prefix and the appended successful command were separately verified.

publication_preparation.relationship_to_audited_snapshot: Subsequent publication-preparation descendant with unchanged scientific runtime. The audit verdict and artifact hashes apply to the named snapshot; later documentation and CI configuration changes are outside that snapshot.

limitations: This is a separate AI-assisted technical audit, not human scientific review or authenticated expert judgment.
Synthetic checks do not establish biological efficacy, empirical control suitability or cross-domain generalization.
Requested 95% percentile intervals retain the documented 74.1% to 93.9% coverage in the measured small-sample experiments.
Screening recognizes specified patterns and cannot certify that all confidential content is detected.
Imported receipts, declared reviewer kinds and retained hashes do not authenticate review or execution.
Linux, macOS, Python 3.11 through 3.13, hosted CI and screen readers were outside this performed scope.
Live literature and hosted-model requests were excluded. Browser background HTTP connection attempts were refused; other browser-internal traffic was not separately measured.
The immutable source distribution contains documented pre-final prose and a syntax-equivalent terminal-blank-line difference; its hash identifies that build snapshot.
Historical reasoning expectation R08 and earlier checker errors remain recorded; this fresh PASS does not retroactively change them.
